proof_body:
by
  intro x t hc ht
  have hp := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (x / 2)
  have h1 : 2 * (x / 2) = x := by ring
  have hs := Real.sin_two_mul (x / 2)
  have hd := Real.cos_two_mul (x / 2)
  rw [h1] at hs hd
  have hd' : 1 + t ^ 2 = 1 / Real.cos (x / 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [ht, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    field_simp
    linarith
  rw [ht, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos] at *
  constructor
  · rw [hd', hs]
    field_simp
  · rw [hd', hd]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ x t : ℝ, Real.cos (x / 2) ≠ 0 → t = Real.tan (x / 2) → Real.sin x = 2 * t / (1 + t ^ 2) ∧ Real.cos x = (1 - t ^ 2) / (1 + t ^ 2)
